mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_knowledge_doc ORDER BY id DESC

SELECT * FROM t_knowledge_doc WHERE file_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR tags LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY CASE WHEN file_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_knowledge_doc (doc_key, file_name, file_type, file_size, file_path, content, parse_status, summary, tags) VALUES (#{docKey}, #{fileName}, #{fileType}, #{fileSize}, #{filePath}, #{content}, #{parseStatus}, #{summary}, #{tags})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_knowledge_doc SET file_name = #{fileName}, file_type = #{fileType}, file_size = #{fileSize}, file_path = #{filePath}, content = #{content}, parse_status = #{parseStatus}, summary = #{summary}, tags = #{tags} WHERE doc_key = #{docKey}
